verdict.rationale: Pipecat's telephony docs describe bots answering calls from the user's own carrier, explicitly naming Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel or 'your SIP provider', and the site lists SIP and PSTN transports. This shows bring-your-own-carrier rather than bundled telephony. The evidence is thin on actual SIP trunk or PBX configuration. missing for 10: documented SIP trunk/PBX setup steps (registration, dial-in/out configuration), explicit guidance on importing existing Twilio/Telnyx numbers, independent or hands-on corroboration of SIP/PBX connectivity.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: the carrier (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, or your SIP provider) is calling your webhook to tell you there's an inbound call
